name: University of Hong Kong
header:
University of Hong Kong
Hong Kong SAR · Mathematics MPhil / 4-year direct-entry PhD / 3-year PhD after research master’s
Canadian/Asian selection; not a US News graduate rank.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• HKPFS initial deadline is noon HKT on 1 December 2026, not the full-application 23:59 cutoff.
• Science expects supervisor discussion and a substantive proposal, including a 250-word maximum
nonspecialist summary.
• A US bachelor’s does not automatically meet the first-class-equivalent direct-PhD threshold.
• Letters start only after application submission; clarify HKPFS timing despite the stated 14-day window.
• Disclose AI assistance as required by HKU/RGC, including research and information retrieval.
• Do not confuse standard PGS with the larger competitive scholarship package or assume tuition/housing is
included.
• Presidential year1 total contains an arithmetic discrepancy; 2027 standard PGS rate remains unconfirmed.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Eligible to seek the MPhil with a recognized honours bachelor’s or equivalent. Direct 4-year PhD requires a
first-class honours bachelor’s equivalent; HKU evaluates the UChicago degree/GPA, so eligibility for that route
is conditional, not automatic. A bachelor’s plus a master’s is another PhD route. The 3-year PhD normally
requires a research master’s. Interviews or qualifying assessment may occur. International applicants are
admitted; US F-1 status supplies no Hong Kong study permission. Complete the bachelor’s before enrollment
and obtain the required Hong Kong student visa. [s2] [s3] [s16]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Discuss a feasible project with a potential supervisor before applying: Science calls this necessary, and its
proposal guidance says an application without a named supportive supervisor is unlikely to succeed. Obtain
consent from two academic referees. Prepare PDF credentials and a Science research proposal; select the PGS
funding option. For HKPFS, first obtain the RGC reference number, then quote it in the HKU application and
select fellowship consideration. Review current portal questions and disclose AI assistance, including
information retrieval, to the extent required by HKU/RGC. [s2] [s5] [s7] [s13] [s14]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Contact prospective supervisors before submission and develop the Science proposal with their guidance.
Science treats prior discussion as necessary and named support as important; neither positive email feedback
nor a supervisor’s interest guarantees admission/funding. Shortlist below is research-matched and includes 12
current faculty; availability for new 2027 students is unconfirmed. General math RPG enquiries:
mathrpg@maths.hku.hk; Science: scirpg@hku.hk; Graduate School: gradsch@hku.hk. [s1] [s2] [s7] [s19]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Public operational guide: an unsubmitted account/application is valid for four weeks; idle sessions expire after
30 minutes. Review before paying/submitting; successful payment authorization generates the application
number and email receipt. After submission, application information and uploaded files cannot be
amended/deleted, although additional documents may be uploaded. Monitor application and reference status.
No account was created and no referee was contacted during this research. [s9]

Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Central application calendar, HKPFS and Presidential awards explicitly cover 2027-28. Standard PGS rate is
effective September 2026 and must be reconfirmed for entry. Department-level deadline text remains
2023-24. Faculty appointments were cross-checked against the current Science roster, including Ngô and new
hire Jinhe Ye; historical personal pages were not accepted as current affiliation evidence. [s4] [s10] [s12] [s13]
[s19]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
For 2027-28 entry: main round 1 September-1 December 2026, closing 23:59 Hong Kong Time (UTC+8). First
clearing round 2 December 2026-30 April 2027, 23:59 HKT; second 1 May-31 August 2027, 23:59 HKT. Clearing
applications depend on vacancies. Review can start before a round closes; use the main round. Mathematics’
own page still displays 2023-24 dates and is not the controlling 2027 calendar. [s4] [s1]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
HKPFS 2027-28: RGC initial application closes 1 December 2026 at 12:00 noon HKT; full HKU application closes
that day at 23:59 HKT. These are distinct deadlines. PGS request is part of admission; HKU Presidential
scholarship consideration is automatic for full-time PhD applicants. HKU-PS applications are accepted through
the normal rounds, but the main round is strongly preferred and later availability is uncertain. No separate
public 2027 PGS deadline beyond the admission round was found. [s4] [s8] [s13] [s15]
Reference receipt [Conflict]
The current supporting-documents rule gives referees 14 days after the application is submitted. No fixed
calendar date is stated for all HKU applicants. This can extend beyond the 1 December academic deadline;
Science’s general instruction to have supporting papers complete by the deadline is less specific. Confirm
whether HKPFS nomination imposes an earlier internal letter cutoff; arrange submission by 1 December where
possible rather than relying on a grace period. [s6] [s2] [s13]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
If English testing is required, send official results by the application deadline and before their two-year validity
expires. Late information may not be considered. For a main-round 2027 application, use 1 December 2026,
23:59 HKT as the complete-file deadline; there is no separately published math test-score grace date. [s6] [s4]
Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
Upload supporting documents by the selected round’s application deadline. Main round: 1 December 2026,
23:59 HKT. The ability to add documents after submission does not guarantee late review.
Conditional-admission final-degree documents have the individualized deadline in the offer. Referee reports
have the separately stated 14-day rule. [s6] [s9] [s4] [s16]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
No universal 2027 commitment date is published. Accept by the deadline in the individual offer through the
online system; conditional and subsequent confirmed offers each require acceptance. A nonrefundable deposit
may be due with confirmed acceptance. It includes caution money, annual student activity fee and the first
tuition installment, with scholarship waivers affecting tuition. Ask CEDARS about a deferral if payment is
difficult. HKPFS results are scheduled for May 2027; this is not a universal acceptance deadline. [s16] [s14]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Testing applies to applicants from institutions outside Hong Kong whose instruction and examination are not
entirely in English. Science follows the general threshold: TOEFL iBT 85 for tests before 21 January 2026, or 4.5
for tests on/after that date; IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with no component below 6.0. Single sitting, within two
years. TOEFL Home Edition and IELTS One Skill Retake are not accepted. Other listed alternatives include
specified GCE/IGCSE or Cambridge proficiency credentials. Official TOEFL delivery: institution 9671,
department 99. [s3] [s6]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
A completed UChicago degree taught and examined entirely in English appears to satisfy the English-medium
exception, independent of citizenship (inference from the published rule). Confirm the evidence HKU wants if
the degree is unfinished at application or if any study was elsewhere; a US F-1 visa itself is irrelevant. No
UChicago-specific waiver form or automatic portal outcome is publicly established. [s3] [s6]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not required for Science according to its FAQ. The central GRE/GMAT requirement applies to specified
Business/Economics or Psychology applicants, not Mathematics. Whether optional math GRE results are
accepted or given weight is not publicly specified; do not interpret “not required” as “not considered.” [s2] [s6]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Not required under Science’s GRE policy. No separate requirement, recommendation, ban, or optional-score
weighting for the Mathematics Subject Test was found in the mathematics/Science instructions. [s1] [s2] [s6]

Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload complete official undergraduate/postgraduate transcripts and degree certificates (latest transcript if
still studying), including grading legend/reverse and final GPA where available; formally translate non-English
documents. Enter cumulative GPA; if absent from transcripts, calculate it using the portal template and upload
PDF. Mainland-earned degrees require CHSI degree verification; additional CHSI qualification/transcript reports
are optional initially. For Mainland applicants with overseas degrees, CSCSE overseas evaluation is optional at
application but may be required after admission; citizenship is unconfirmed here. [s6]
Mathematics-course list [Unresolved]
No separate mathematics-course list is specified in the public Mathematics/Science checklist. Complete
transcripts remain required. Verify whether the current portal adds a course-history field; no separate length or
format established. [s1] [s2] [s6]
Course descriptions [Unresolved]

Do not assume an unsolicited upload is needed; ask the supervisor or department if preparation equivalence

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Two academic referees who know the applicant’s achievements and research potential. Obtain consent before
nomination. Professional/nonacademic referees are not considered appropriate. [s6]
Scholarship references [Unresolved]
No third or separate additional referee is publicly specified for HKPFS or HKU-PS. HKPFS assessment includes
research potential, communication/interpersonal skills and leadership as well as academic performance. Exact

scholarship-specific referee questions and whether the electronic report differs are not publicly exposed in the
sources reviewed; confirm the current form before briefing referees. [s6] [s13] [s14]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Entering referee details alone does not trigger the invitation under the published rule. The system emails the
nominated referees once the application is submitted. [s6]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Yes: invitations are sent after submission, with 14 days to complete the online report. Submission occurs after
successful payment authorization in the operational guide. [s6] [s9]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
The applicant can check referee-report submission status in the online application system. This confirms
receipt/status, not access to confidential report contents. [s6] [s9]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Under exceptional circumstances, up to two new referees may replace nominated referees who fail to report by
their deadline through the portal. Public instructions do not establish whether a submitted letter can be
revised, reused across departments or carried to another cycle; ask Graduate School before relying on any
reuse. [s6]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Unresolved]
An academic CV is not expressly named as mandatory in the public Mathematics/Science checklist. The central
checklist allows optional evidence of relevant experience and qualifications; whether a dedicated CV upload is
offered must be checked in the live application. No published CV length or typography rule. [s1] [s2] [s6]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
No separate conventional statement of purpose is specified for Mathematics. Science requires a research
proposal; do not replace it with a generic SOP. General guidance for a research-interest statement includes
reasons for graduate work at HKU, but Science’s faculty-specific proposal rule governs. Separate SOP prompt,
limit and upload field remain unverified. [s6] [s7]
Personal / background statement [Unresolved]
No separate personal/background/diversity statement is named in the public Mathematics/Science admission
checklist. HKPFS has a separate vision statement (see scholarship writing). Any additional portal-only
prompt/limit must be inspected before drafting. [s1] [s6] [s7]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Research interests are addressed through the required Science proposal and identification of an appropriate
supervisor. A stand-alone research-interest statement is not established as an alternative to that proposal for
Science; general central wording should not be substituted for the faculty-specific rule. [s6] [s7]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
Required for both MPhil and PhD in Science. Faithful paraphrase of the official suggested template: applicant
name; project title; accessible nonspecialist summary (maximum 250 words); background/motivation;
objectives or hypotheses; critical literature review; proposed methods/approach; anticipated outcomes and
significance; bibliography. Adapt or omit inapplicable sections. No fixed overall length is prescribed; PhD
proposals should explain context, importance and approach in greater depth. Name a supportive proposed
supervisor. Upload PDF; no published font, spacing or overall page cap. Source s7 contains the complete
template. [s7] [s6]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
No compulsory mathematics writing sample/thesis upload is specified. The central 10-/15-page writing-sample
rules belong to the Humanities and Social Sciences institute and must not be imported into Mathematics.

Optional general supporting documents are allowed, but whether a full mathematics paper/thesis is wanted or
should be linked rather than uploaded is unresolved. [s6] [s7]
Publications list [Standing rule]
Optional publications list is expressly allowed among additional supporting documents. No requirement to have
publications, no list-length limit, and no instruction to upload full papers versus supply links is published. Use
the current portal’s field and confirm with the proposed supervisor before adding large manuscripts. [s6]
Course-list document [Unresolved]
No separate written mathematics-course list prompt, length, format or upload rule is published in the reviewed
checklist. Transcript requirements are separate; current-portal verification is needed. [s1] [s6]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
HKPFS full applications include a proposed research plan, past research experience and a vision statement;
these may undergo plagiarism checks. Exact HKU prompts, character limits and text-box/upload mechanics
were not exposed publicly in the current sources, so inspect them before drafting and do not borrow another
Hong Kong university’s limits. The initial RGC form covers identity, up to two ranked programme choices,
declarations and source of information; it is not the full essay application. HKU-PS consideration is automatic
without a separately advertised essay. RGC guidance also requests, where applicable, explanations of data
collection/consent, organization/security/preservation, sharing/access and legal or cross-border compliance;
pure-math applicability should be clarified. The RGC initial application additionally limits research keywords to
100 characters. [s6] [s8] [s14] [s40]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Required identity PDF: passport biographical page and applicable Hong Kong/Mainland identity or existing visa
documents. All uploads PDF, at most 1.5 MB each and 50 MB total. Avoid duplicate postal submission, apart
from official test delivery. AI disclosure must identify tools, purposes, manner and extent of use, including
information retrieval, literature review, language editing and research development. Check and take
responsibility for all resulting content; the exact disclosure field/length is not publicly specified. [s6] [s14]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Conflict]
Standard PGS, effective 1 September 2026: HKD19,135/month before PhD probation confirmation;
HKD19,655/month afterward, from the following month. Twelve-month arithmetic equivalents: HKD229,620
and 235,860 gross; these are current rates, not a guaranteed 2027 rate. Tuition is separate: full-time 2027-28
HKD49,500/year. HKPFS/HKU-PS 2027-28 stipend: HKD28,700/month = HKD344,400/year, plus
HKD14,400/year travel, tuition waiver, HKD40,000 cash in year1 and HKD20,000 in later normative years.
Housing place is guaranteed in year1 but is not stated to be free. Medical insurance/other-fee coverage is not
established. The Presidential page’s HKD445,800 year1 aggregate conflicts with its listed components, which
total HKD448,300; use components pending clarification. [s10] [s12] [s13] [s16] [s18]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Standard PGS is normally renewable annually through the normative period, subject to satisfactory progress
and available funds: MPhil 2 years; PhD 3 or 4 years according to route. Transfers count prior funded
registration. RGC supports HKPFS for 3 years; HKU supplies equivalent support in year4 of a 4-year PhD. Tuition
waiver and Presidential cash awards cover the normative period; an extra year is available only to selected
outstanding students, not guaranteed. Monthly stipend implies year-round payments while eligible, not a
nine-month salary. [s11] [s13] [s12]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
PGS and HKPFS/HKU-PS support nonlocal students; HKPFS expressly allows applicants from any country/ethnic
background who seek a new full-time PhD. Standard PGS eligibility includes at least upper-second-class
bachelor’s equivalent and full-time enrollment. Local-student tuition waivers and listed local hardship bursaries

do not automatically extend to an international applicant. Citizenship affects Belt and Road scholarship
eligibility; US F-1 status establishes none of these categories. [s10] [s13] [s17]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
PGS depends on funds, satisfactory progress and required training/service. Recipients may have up to 100
hours of departmental services per 12 months, including preparation, without extra payment. Additional
employment is subject to prior approval, a separate hours ceiling and immigration restrictions. Tuition remains
the student’s responsibility unless specifically waived. New students also face HKD350 caution money and
HKD100 annual full-time student activity fee. Do not combine standard PGS and enhanced HKPFS/HKU-PS
stipends as additive awards. [s11] [s16] [s2]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Request PGS in the admission application; no separate PGS application form. All full-time PhD applicants are
considered for HKU-PS automatically. HKPFS requires the separate RGC initial registration and university full

Pay attention to
• HKPFS initial deadline is noon HKT on 1 December 2026, not the full-application 23:59 cutoff.
• Science expects supervisor discussion and a substantive proposal, including a 250-word maximum
nonspecialist summary.
• A US bachelor’s does not automatically meet the first-class-equivalent direct-PhD threshold.
• Letters start only after application submission; clarify HKPFS timing despite the stated 14-day window.
• Disclose AI assistance as required by HKU/RGC, including research and information retrieval.
• Do not confuse standard PGS with the larger competitive scholarship package or assume tuition/housing is
included.
• Presidential year1 total contains an arithmetic discrepancy; 2027 standard PGS rate remains unconfirmed.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Eligible to seek the MPhil with a recognized honours bachelor’s or equivalent. Direct 4-year PhD requires a
first-class honours bachelor’s equivalent; HKU evaluates the UChicago degree/GPA, so eligibility for that route
is conditional, not automatic. A bachelor’s plus a master’s is another PhD route. The 3-year PhD normally
requires a research master’s. Interviews or qualifying assessment may occur. International applicants are
admitted; US F-1 status supplies no Hong Kong study permission. Complete the bachelor’s before enrollment
and obtain the required Hong Kong student visa. [s2] [s3] [s16]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Discuss a feasible project with a potential supervisor before applying: Science calls this necessary, and its
proposal guidance says an application without a named supportive supervisor is unlikely to succeed. Obtain
consent from two academic referees. Prepare PDF credentials and a Science research proposal; select the PGS
funding option. For HKPFS, first obtain the RGC reference number, then quote it in the HKU application and
select fellowship consideration. Review current portal questions and disclose AI assistance, including
information retrieval, to the extent required by HKU/RGC. [s2] [s5] [s7] [s13] [s14]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Contact prospective supervisors before submission and develop the Science proposal with their guidance.
Science treats prior discussion as necessary and named support as important; neither positive email feedback
nor a supervisor’s interest guarantees admission/funding. Shortlist below is research-matched and includes 12
current faculty; availability for new 2027 students is unconfirmed. General math RPG enquiries:
mathrpg@maths.hku.hk; Science: scirpg@hku.hk; Graduate School: gradsch@hku.hk. [s1] [s2] [s7] [s19]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Public operational guide: an unsubmitted account/application is valid for four weeks; idle sessions expire after
30 minutes. Review before paying/submitting; successful payment authorization generates the application
number and email receipt. After submission, application information and uploaded files cannot be
amended/deleted, although additional documents may be uploaded. Monitor application and reference status.
No account was created and no referee was contacted during this research. [s9]

HKPFS 2027-28: RGC initial application closes 1 December 2026 at 12:00 noon HKT; full HKU application closes

scholarship consideration is automatic for full-time PhD applicants. HKU-PS applications are accepted through

whether HKPFS nomination imposes an earlier internal letter cutoff; arrange submission by 1 December where
possible rather than relying on a grace period. [s6] [s2] [s13]

If English testing is required, send official results by the application deadline and before their two-year validity
expires. Late information may not be considered. For a main-round 2027 application, use 1 December 2026,

have the separately stated 14-day rule. [s6] [s9] [s4] [s16]

online system; conditional and subsequent confirmed offers each require acceptance. A nonrefundable deposit
may be due with confirmed acceptance. It includes caution money, annual student activity fee and the first
tuition installment, with scholarship waivers affecting tuition. Ask CEDARS about a deferral if payment is
difficult. HKPFS results are scheduled for May 2027; this is not a universal acceptance deadline. [s16] [s14]

English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
Testing applies to applicants from institutions outside Hong Kong whose instruction and examination are not
entirely in English. Science follows the general threshold: TOEFL iBT 85 for tests before 21 January 2026, or 4.5
for tests on/after that date; IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with no component below 6.0. Single sitting, within two
years. TOEFL Home Edition and IELTS One Skill Retake are not accepted. Other listed alternatives include
specified GCE/IGCSE or Cambridge proficiency credentials. Official TOEFL delivery: institution 9671,
department 99. [s3] [s6]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
A completed UChicago degree taught and examined entirely in English appears to satisfy the English-medium
exception, independent of citizenship (inference from the published rule). Confirm the evidence HKU wants if
the degree is unfinished at application or if any study was elsewhere; a US F-1 visa itself is irrelevant. No
UChicago-specific waiver form or automatic portal outcome is publicly established. [s3] [s6]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not required for Science according to its FAQ. The central GRE/GMAT requirement applies to specified
Business/Economics or Psychology applicants, not Mathematics. Whether optional math GRE results are
accepted or given weight is not publicly specified; do not interpret “not required” as “not considered.” [s2] [s6]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Not required under Science’s GRE policy. No separate requirement, recommendation, ban, or optional-score
weighting for the Mathematics Subject Test was found in the mathematics/Science instructions. [s1] [s2] [s6]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload complete official undergraduate/postgraduate transcripts and degree certificates (latest transcript if
still studying), including grading legend/reverse and final GPA where available; formally translate non-English
documents. Enter cumulative GPA; if absent from transcripts, calculate it using the portal template and upload
PDF. Mainland-earned degrees require CHSI degree verification; additional CHSI qualification/transcript reports
are optional initially. For Mainland applicants with overseas degrees, CSCSE overseas evaluation is optional at
application but may be required after admission; citizenship is unconfirmed here. [s6]
Mathematics-course list [Unresolved]
No separate mathematics-course list is specified in the public Mathematics/Science checklist. Complete
transcripts remain required. Verify whether the current portal adds a course-history field; no separate length or
format established. [s1] [s2] [s6]
Course descriptions [Unresolved]

Do not assume an unsolicited upload is needed; ask the supervisor or department if preparation equivalence
needs clarification. [s1] [s2] [s6]

nomination. Professional/nonacademic referees are not considered appropriate. [s6]

research potential, communication/interpersonal skills and leadership as well as academic performance. Exact

Entering referee details alone does not trigger the invitation under the published rule. The system emails the

Under exceptional circumstances, up to two new referees may replace nominated referees who fail to report by

Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Unresolved]
An academic CV is not expressly named as mandatory in the public Mathematics/Science checklist. The central
checklist allows optional evidence of relevant experience and qualifications; whether a dedicated CV upload is
offered must be checked in the live application. No published CV length or typography rule. [s1] [s2] [s6]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
No separate conventional statement of purpose is specified for Mathematics. Science requires a research
proposal; do not replace it with a generic SOP. General guidance for a research-interest statement includes
reasons for graduate work at HKU, but Science’s faculty-specific proposal rule governs. Separate SOP prompt,
limit and upload field remain unverified. [s6] [s7]
Personal / background statement [Unresolved]
No separate personal/background/diversity statement is named in the public Mathematics/Science admission
checklist. HKPFS has a separate vision statement (see scholarship writing). Any additional portal-only
prompt/limit must be inspected before drafting. [s1] [s6] [s7]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Research interests are addressed through the required Science proposal and identification of an appropriate
supervisor. A stand-alone research-interest statement is not established as an alternative to that proposal for
Science; general central wording should not be substituted for the faculty-specific rule. [s6] [s7]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
Required for both MPhil and PhD in Science. Faithful paraphrase of the official suggested template: applicant
name; project title; accessible nonspecialist summary (maximum 250 words); background/motivation;
objectives or hypotheses; critical literature review; proposed methods/approach; anticipated outcomes and
significance; bibliography. Adapt or omit inapplicable sections. No fixed overall length is prescribed; PhD
proposals should explain context, importance and approach in greater depth. Name a supportive proposed
supervisor. Upload PDF; no published font, spacing or overall page cap. Source s7 contains the complete
template. [s7] [s6]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
No compulsory mathematics writing sample/thesis upload is specified. The central 10-/15-page writing-sample
rules belong to the Humanities and Social Sciences institute and must not be imported into Mathematics.

Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
HKPFS full applications include a proposed research plan, past research experience and a vision statement;
these may undergo plagiarism checks. Exact HKU prompts, character limits and text-box/upload mechanics
were not exposed publicly in the current sources, so inspect them before drafting and do not borrow another
Hong Kong university’s limits. The initial RGC form covers identity, up to two ranked programme choices,
declarations and source of information; it is not the full essay application. HKU-PS consideration is automatic
without a separately advertised essay. RGC guidance also requests, where applicable, explanations of data
collection/consent, organization/security/preservation, sharing/access and legal or cross-border compliance;
pure-math applicability should be clarified. The RGC initial application additionally limits research keywords to
100 characters. [s6] [s8] [s14] [s40]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Required identity PDF: passport biographical page and applicable Hong Kong/Mainland identity or existing visa
documents. All uploads PDF, at most 1.5 MB each and 50 MB total. Avoid duplicate postal submission, apart
from official test delivery. AI disclosure must identify tools, purposes, manner and extent of use, including
information retrieval, literature review, language editing and research development. Check and take
responsibility for all resulting content; the exact disclosure field/length is not publicly specified. [s6] [s14]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Conflict]
Standard PGS, effective 1 September 2026: HKD19,135/month before PhD probation confirmation;
HKD19,655/month afterward, from the following month. Twelve-month arithmetic equivalents: HKD229,620
and 235,860 gross; these are current rates, not a guaranteed 2027 rate. Tuition is separate: full-time 2027-28
HKD49,500/year. HKPFS/HKU-PS 2027-28 stipend: HKD28,700/month = HKD344,400/year, plus
HKD14,400/year travel, tuition waiver, HKD40,000 cash in year1 and HKD20,000 in later normative years.
Housing place is guaranteed in year1 but is not stated to be free. Medical insurance/other-fee coverage is not
established. The Presidential page’s HKD445,800 year1 aggregate conflicts with its listed components, which
total HKD448,300; use components pending clarification. [s10] [s12] [s13] [s16] [s18]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Standard PGS is normally renewable annually through the normative period, subject to satisfactory progress
and available funds: MPhil 2 years; PhD 3 or 4 years according to route. Transfers count prior funded
registration. RGC supports HKPFS for 3 years; HKU supplies equivalent support in year4 of a 4-year PhD. Tuition
waiver and Presidential cash awards cover the normative period; an extra year is available only to selected
outstanding students, not guaranteed. Monthly stipend implies year-round payments while eligible, not a
nine-month salary. [s11] [s13] [s12]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
PGS and HKPFS/HKU-PS support nonlocal students; HKPFS expressly allows applicants from any country/ethnic
background who seek a new full-time PhD. Standard PGS eligibility includes at least upper-second-class
bachelor’s equivalent and full-time enrollment. Local-student tuition waivers and listed local hardship bursaries

Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
PGS depends on funds, satisfactory progress and required training/service. Recipients may have up to 100
hours of departmental services per 12 months, including preparation, without extra payment. Additional
employment is subject to prior approval, a separate hours ceiling and immigration restrictions. Tuition remains
the student’s responsibility unless specifically waived. New students also face HKD350 caution money and
HKD100 annual full-time student activity fee. Do not combine standard PGS and enhanced HKPFS/HKU-PS
stipends as additive awards. [s11] [s16] [s2]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Request PGS in the admission application; no separate PGS application form. All full-time PhD applicants are
considered for HKU-PS automatically. HKPFS requires the separate RGC initial registration and university full
application with the reference number; only one RGC initial application is allowed, with up to two ranked
choices across one/two universities. Choices lock at the RGC deadline; refusing the first-choice award does not
transfer it to the second choice. [s8] [s13] [s14]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
HKU lists travel/conference support, publication and innovation awards, a Dissertation Year Fellowship, Li Ka
Shing Prizes and outstanding-research awards; these are supplementary competitions, not guaranteed
entrance income. Belt and Road research scholarships cover tuition for eligible first-year nonlocal students
from qualifying countries, subject to renewal/progress; Faculty invites eligible applicants. Exact 2027
nomination dates, essay/reference details and citizenship eligibility need individual verification. [s17]
Application fee [Standing rule]
HKD780 per university application, nonrefundable and nontransferable; pay online with Visa or Mastercard.
RGC’s initial HKPFS application is free, but it does not replace the university fee. Only one application per
department is permitted regardless of degree/mode; separate departments require separate
application/document sets and fees. [s8] [s9] [s14]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Graduate School FAQ explicitly says application-fee waiver requests will not be considered. This differs from
possible admission-deposit/payment deferral after an offer, which CEDARS can assess. [s8] [s16]

preparation/upload before submission and additions afterward; follow s9. (3) central supervisor contact is

named supervisor; follow the faculty-specific expectation. (4) general supporting-document deadline versus
the explicit 14-day referee window needs HKPFS clarification. The Presidential year1 aggregate is also

University of Hong Kong
Hong Kong SAR · Mathematics MPhil / 4-year direct-entry PhD / 3-year PhD after research master’s
Canadian/Asian selection; not a US News graduate rank.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• HKPFS initial deadline is noon HKT on 1 December 2026, not the full-application 23:59 cutoff.
• Science expects supervisor discussion and a substantive proposal, including a 250-word maximum
nonspecialist summary.
• A US bachelor’s does not automatically meet the first-class-equivalent direct-PhD threshold.
• Letters start only after application submission; clarify HKPFS timing despite the stated 14-day window.
• Disclose AI assistance as required by HKU/RGC, including research and information retrieval.
• Do not confuse standard PGS with the larger competitive scholarship package or assume tuition/housing is
included.
• Presidential year1 total contains an arithmetic discrepancy; 2027 standard PGS rate remains unconfirmed.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Eligible to seek the MPhil with a recognized honours bachelor’s or equivalent. Direct 4-year PhD requires a
first-class honours bachelor’s equivalent; HKU evaluates the UChicago degree/GPA, so eligibility for that route
is conditional, not automatic. A bachelor’s plus a master’s is another PhD route. The 3-year PhD normally
requires a research master’s. Interviews or qualifying assessment may occur. International applicants are
admitted; US F-1 status supplies no Hong Kong study permission. Complete the bachelor’s before enrollment
and obtain the required Hong Kong student visa. [s2] [s3] [s16]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Discuss a feasible project with a potential supervisor before applying: Science calls this necessary, and its
proposal guidance says an application without a named supportive supervisor is unlikely to succeed. Obtain
consent from two academic referees. Prepare PDF credentials and a Science research proposal; select the PGS
funding option. For HKPFS, first obtain the RGC reference number, then quote it in the HKU application and
select fellowship consideration. Review current portal questions and disclose AI assistance, including
information retrieval, to the extent required by HKU/RGC. [s2] [s5] [s7] [s13] [s14]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Contact prospective supervisors before submission and develop the Science proposal with their guidance.
Science treats prior discussion as necessary and named support as important; neither positive email feedback
nor a supervisor’s interest guarantees admission/funding. Shortlist below is research-matched and includes 12
current faculty; availability for new 2027 students is unconfirmed. General math RPG enquiries:
mathrpg@maths.hku.hk; Science: scirpg@hku.hk; Graduate School: gradsch@hku.hk. [s1] [s2] [s7] [s19]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Public operational guide: an unsubmitted account/application is valid for four weeks; idle sessions expire after
30 minutes. Review before paying/submitting; successful payment authorization generates the application
number and email receipt. After submission, application information and uploaded files cannot be
amended/deleted, although additional documents may be uploaded. Monitor application and reference status.
No account was created and no referee was contacted during this research. [s9]

Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Central application calendar, HKPFS and Presidential awards explicitly cover 2027-28. Standard PGS rate is
effective September 2026 and must be reconfirmed for entry. Department-level deadline text remains
2023-24. Faculty appointments were cross-checked against the current Science roster, including Ngô and new
hire Jinhe Ye; historical personal pages were not accepted as current affiliation evidence. [s4] [s10] [s12] [s13]
[s19]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
For 2027-28 entry: main round 1 September-1 December 2026, closing 23:59 Hong Kong Time (UTC+8). First
clearing round 2 December 2026-30 April 2027, 23:59 HKT; second 1 May-31 August 2027, 23:59 HKT. Clearing
applications depend on vacancies. Review can start before a round closes; use the main round. Mathematics’
own page still displays 2023-24 dates and is not the controlling 2027 calendar. [s4] [s1]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
HKPFS 2027-28: RGC initial application closes 1 December 2026 at 12:00 noon HKT; full HKU application closes
that day at 23:59 HKT. These are distinct deadlines. PGS request is part of admission; HKU Presidential
scholarship consideration is automatic for full-time PhD applicants. HKU-PS applications are accepted through
the normal rounds, but the main round is strongly preferred and later availability is uncertain. No separate
public 2027 PGS deadline beyond the admission round was found. [s4] [s8] [s13] [s15]
Reference receipt [Conflict]
The current supporting-documents rule gives referees 14 days after the application is submitted. No fixed
calendar date is stated for all HKU applicants. This can extend beyond the 1 December academic deadline;
Science’s general instruction to have supporting papers complete by the deadline is less specific. Confirm
whether HKPFS nomination imposes an earlier internal letter cutoff; arrange submission by 1 December where
possible rather than relying on a grace period. [s6] [s2] [s13]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
If English testing is required, send official results by the application deadline and before their two-year validity
expires. Late information may not be considered. For a main-round 2027 application, use 1 December 2026,
23:59 HKT as the complete-file deadline; there is no separately published math test-score grace date. [s6] [s4]
Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
Upload supporting documents by the selected round’s application deadline. Main round: 1 December 2026,
23:59 HKT. The ability to add documents after submission does not guarantee late review.
Conditional-admission final-degree documents have the individualized deadline in the offer. Referee reports
have the separately stated 14-day rule. [s6] [s9] [s4] [s16]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
No universal 2027 commitment date is published. Accept by the deadline in the individual offer through the
online system; conditional and subsequent confirmed offers each require acceptance. A nonrefundable deposit
may be due with confirmed acceptance. It includes caution money, annual student activity fee and the first
tuition installment, with scholarship waivers affecting tuition. Ask CEDARS about a deferral if payment is
difficult. HKPFS results are scheduled for May 2027; this is not a universal acceptance deadline. [s16] [s14]

English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
Testing applies to applicants from institutions outside Hong Kong whose instruction and examination are not
entirely in English. Science follows the general threshold: TOEFL iBT 85 for tests before 21 January 2026, or 4.5
for tests on/after that date; IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with no component below 6.0. Single sitting, within two
years. TOEFL Home Edition and IELTS One Skill Retake are not accepted. Other listed alternatives include
specified GCE/IGCSE or Cambridge proficiency credentials. Official TOEFL delivery: institution 9671,
department 99. [s3] [s6]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
A completed UChicago degree taught and examined entirely in English appears to satisfy the English-medium
exception, independent of citizenship (inference from the published rule). Confirm the evidence HKU wants if
the degree is unfinished at application or if any study was elsewhere; a US F-1 visa itself is irrelevant. No
UChicago-specific waiver form or automatic portal outcome is publicly established. [s3] [s6]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not required for Science according to its FAQ. The central GRE/GMAT requirement applies to specified
Business/Economics or Psychology applicants, not Mathematics. Whether optional math GRE results are
accepted or given weight is not publicly specified; do not interpret “not required” as “not considered.” [s2] [s6]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Not required under Science’s GRE policy. No separate requirement, recommendation, ban, or optional-score
weighting for the Mathematics Subject Test was found in the mathematics/Science instructions. [s1] [s2] [s6]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload complete official undergraduate/postgraduate transcripts and degree certificates (latest transcript if
still studying), including grading legend/reverse and final GPA where available; formally translate non-English
documents. Enter cumulative GPA; if absent from transcripts, calculate it using the portal template and upload
PDF. Mainland-earned degrees require CHSI degree verification; additional CHSI qualification/transcript reports
are optional initially. For Mainland applicants with overseas degrees, CSCSE overseas evaluation is optional at
application but may be required after admission; citizenship is unconfirmed here. [s6]
Mathematics-course list [Unresolved]
No separate mathematics-course list is specified in the public Mathematics/Science checklist. Complete
transcripts remain required. Verify whether the current portal adds a course-history field; no separate length or
format established. [s1] [s2] [s6]
Course descriptions [Unresolved]
No syllabus/course-description upload requirement was found in the public Mathematics/Science instructions.
Do not assume an unsolicited upload is needed; ask the supervisor or department if preparation equivalence
needs clarification. [s1] [s2] [s6]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Two academic referees who know the applicant’s achievements and research potential. Obtain consent before
nomination. Professional/nonacademic referees are not considered appropriate. [s6]
Scholarship references [Unresolved]
No third or separate additional referee is publicly specified for HKPFS or HKU-PS. HKPFS assessment includes
research potential, communication/interpersonal skills and leadership as well as academic performance. Exact

scholarship-specific referee questions and whether the electronic report differs are not publicly exposed in the
sources reviewed; confirm the current form before briefing referees. [s6] [s13] [s14]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Entering referee details alone does not trigger the invitation under the published rule. The system emails the
nominated referees once the application is submitted. [s6]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Yes: invitations are sent after submission, with 14 days to complete the online report. Submission occurs after
successful payment authorization in the operational guide. [s6] [s9]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
The applicant can check referee-report submission status in the online application system. This confirms
receipt/status, not access to confidential report contents. [s6] [s9]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Under exceptional circumstances, up to two new referees may replace nominated referees who fail to report by
their deadline through the portal. Public instructions do not establish whether a submitted letter can be
revised, reused across departments or carried to another cycle; ask Graduate School before relying on any
reuse. [s6]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Unresolved]
An academic CV is not expressly named as mandatory in the public Mathematics/Science checklist. The central
checklist allows optional evidence of relevant experience and qualifications; whether a dedicated CV upload is
offered must be checked in the live application. No published CV length or typography rule. [s1] [s2] [s6]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
No separate conventional statement of purpose is specified for Mathematics. Science requires a research
proposal; do not replace it with a generic SOP. General guidance for a research-interest statement includes
reasons for graduate work at HKU, but Science’s faculty-specific proposal rule governs. Separate SOP prompt,
limit and upload field remain unverified. [s6] [s7]
Personal / background statement [Unresolved]
No separate personal/background/diversity statement is named in the public Mathematics/Science admission
checklist. HKPFS has a separate vision statement (see scholarship writing). Any additional portal-only
prompt/limit must be inspected before drafting. [s1] [s6] [s7]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Research interests are addressed through the required Science proposal and identification of an appropriate
supervisor. A stand-alone research-interest statement is not established as an alternative to that proposal for
Science; general central wording should not be substituted for the faculty-specific rule. [s6] [s7]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
Required for both MPhil and PhD in Science. Faithful paraphrase of the official suggested template: applicant
name; project title; accessible nonspecialist summary (maximum 250 words); background/motivation;
objectives or hypotheses; critical literature review; proposed methods/approach; anticipated outcomes and
significance; bibliography. Adapt or omit inapplicable sections. No fixed overall length is prescribed; PhD
proposals should explain context, importance and approach in greater depth. Name a supportive proposed
supervisor. Upload PDF; no published font, spacing or overall page cap. Source s7 contains the complete
template. [s7] [s6]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
No compulsory mathematics writing sample/thesis upload is specified. The central 10-/15-page writing-sample
rules belong to the Humanities and Social Sciences institute and must not be imported into Mathematics.

Optional general supporting documents are allowed, but whether a full mathematics paper/thesis is wanted or
should be linked rather than uploaded is unresolved. [s6] [s7]
Publications list [Standing rule]
Optional publications list is expressly allowed among additional supporting documents. No requirement to have
publications, no list-length limit, and no instruction to upload full papers versus supply links is published. Use
the current portal’s field and confirm with the proposed supervisor before adding large manuscripts. [s6]
Course-list document [Unresolved]
No separate written mathematics-course list prompt, length, format or upload rule is published in the reviewed
checklist. Transcript requirements are separate; current-portal verification is needed. [s1] [s6]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
HKPFS full applications include a proposed research plan, past research experience and a vision statement;
these may undergo plagiarism checks. Exact HKU prompts, character limits and text-box/upload mechanics
were not exposed publicly in the current sources, so inspect them before drafting and do not borrow another
Hong Kong university’s limits. The initial RGC form covers identity, up to two ranked programme choices,
declarations and source of information; it is not the full essay application. HKU-PS consideration is automatic
without a separately advertised essay. RGC guidance also requests, where applicable, explanations of data
collection/consent, organization/security/preservation, sharing/access and legal or cross-border compliance;
pure-math applicability should be clarified. The RGC initial application additionally limits research keywords to
100 characters. [s6] [s8] [s14] [s40]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Required identity PDF: passport biographical page and applicable Hong Kong/Mainland identity or existing visa
documents. All uploads PDF, at most 1.5 MB each and 50 MB total. Avoid duplicate postal submission, apart
from official test delivery. AI disclosure must identify tools, purposes, manner and extent of use, including
information retrieval, literature review, language editing and research development. Check and take
responsibility for all resulting content; the exact disclosure field/length is not publicly specified. [s6] [s14]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Conflict]
Standard PGS, effective 1 September 2026: HKD19,135/month before PhD probation confirmation;
HKD19,655/month afterward, from the following month. Twelve-month arithmetic equivalents: HKD229,620
and 235,860 gross; these are current rates, not a guaranteed 2027 rate. Tuition is separate: full-time 2027-28
HKD49,500/year. HKPFS/HKU-PS 2027-28 stipend: HKD28,700/month = HKD344,400/year, plus
HKD14,400/year travel, tuition waiver, HKD40,000 cash in year1 and HKD20,000 in later normative years.
Housing place is guaranteed in year1 but is not stated to be free. Medical insurance/other-fee coverage is not
established. The Presidential page’s HKD445,800 year1 aggregate conflicts with its listed components, which
total HKD448,300; use components pending clarification. [s10] [s12] [s13] [s16] [s18]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Standard PGS is normally renewable annually through the normative period, subject to satisfactory progress
and available funds: MPhil 2 years; PhD 3 or 4 years according to route. Transfers count prior funded
registration. RGC supports HKPFS for 3 years; HKU supplies equivalent support in year4 of a 4-year PhD. Tuition
waiver and Presidential cash awards cover the normative period; an extra year is available only to selected
outstanding students, not guaranteed. Monthly stipend implies year-round payments while eligible, not a
nine-month salary. [s11] [s13] [s12]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
PGS and HKPFS/HKU-PS support nonlocal students; HKPFS expressly allows applicants from any country/ethnic
background who seek a new full-time PhD. Standard PGS eligibility includes at least upper-second-class
bachelor’s equivalent and full-time enrollment. Local-student tuition waivers and listed local hardship bursaries

do not automatically extend to an international applicant. Citizenship affects Belt and Road scholarship
eligibility; US F-1 status establishes none of these categories. [s10] [s13] [s17]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
PGS depends on funds, satisfactory progress and required training/service. Recipients may have up to 100
hours of departmental services per 12 months, including preparation, without extra payment. Additional
employment is subject to prior approval, a separate hours ceiling and immigration restrictions. Tuition remains
the student’s responsibility unless specifically waived. New students also face HKD350 caution money and
HKD100 annual full-time student activity fee. Do not combine standard PGS and enhanced HKPFS/HKU-PS
stipends as additive awards. [s11] [s16] [s2]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Request PGS in the admission application; no separate PGS application form. All full-time PhD applicants are
considered for HKU-PS automatically. HKPFS requires the separate RGC initial registration and university full
application with the reference number; only one RGC initial application is allowed, with up to two ranked
choices across one/two universities. Choices lock at the RGC deadline; refusing the first-choice award does not
transfer it to the second choice. [s8] [s13] [s14]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
HKU lists travel/conference support, publication and innovation awards, a Dissertation Year Fellowship, Li Ka
Shing Prizes and outstanding-research awards; these are supplementary competitions, not guaranteed
entrance income. Belt and Road research scholarships cover tuition for eligible first-year nonlocal students
from qualifying countries, subject to renewal/progress; Faculty invites eligible applicants. Exact 2027
nomination dates, essay/reference details and citizenship eligibility need individual verification. [s17]
Application fee [Standing rule]
HKD780 per university application, nonrefundable and nontransferable; pay online with Visa or Mastercard.
RGC’s initial HKPFS application is free, but it does not replace the university fee. Only one application per
department is permitted regardless of degree/mode; separate departments require separate
application/document sets and fees. [s8] [s9] [s14]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Graduate School FAQ explicitly says application-fee waiver requests will not be considered. This differs from
possible admission-deposit/payment deferral after an offer, which CEDARS can assess. [s8] [s16]
Conflicts and remaining checks
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
Four operational discrepancies: (1) old department 2023-24 dates versus current central 2027-28 calendar;
use s4. (2) Science FAQ describes uploading after payment, while the current operational guide allows
preparation/upload before submission and additions afterward; follow s9. (3) central supervisor contact is
presented as optional, while Science requires prior discussion and its proposal guidance expects a supportive
named supervisor; follow the faculty-specific expectation. (4) general supporting-document deadline versus
the explicit 14-day referee window needs HKPFS clarification. The Presidential year1 aggregate is also
arithmetically inconsistent with listed benefits. [s1] [s2] [s4] [s5] [s6] [s7] [s9] [s12]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Confirm direct-PhD first-class equivalence for the actual UChicago record; proposed supervisor’s 2027
capacity; English-medium evidence while degree is pending; HKPFS exact essay prompts/limits, referee
questions and internal letter cutoff; letter revision/reuse; any dedicated CV/course-list or optional-paper fields;
2027 PGS rate and net budget after fees/housing; Presidential aggregate correction; offer-specific
acceptance/deposit deadlines. Public admission, Science FAQ, proposal document, portal guide, funding
regulations and current faculty/paper sources were checked; these remaining points were not silently inferred.
